title: Bad Pour (makes a mess)
text: Bad Pour (makes a mess). I was looking for a cast iron pot.  Searched for cast iron pots in Amazon.  This came up. This is ceramic. Cast iron was listed in materials. I assumed the ceramic was the cups. I was wrong. Who wants to use one pot to boil water for another?!?!?!?!?  It's a nice looking set. Wife likes it and wants to keep it. Who am I to argue.  Biggest issue is it is a bad pour (dribbles down the front when pouring).
